verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own marketing describes fixing issues remotely, and community users report it working for remote connections to relatives' machines. However, nothing in the pack documents how the connection is established (relay/broker, VPN, or port forwarding). The home-VPN setup in one community post is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of the relay/brokered connection path, NAT traversal or port-forward guidance, any VPN mode, and independent hands-on confirmation of away-from-home access.
